card.name: Words marking time since the past
card.fires_on: Words that place an event in the past, such as 'ago' after 'a century' or 'long', 'since' after elapsed time, and ordinal anniversaries. Also 'Museum' in dated museum names.

modes.label: Time-elapsed words
modes.description: 'ago', 'since' or 'half' ending a phrase about how long back something happened.

modes.description: 'Museum' or an ordinal such as 'th' in a name or anniversary followed by a year or date.
